name: Team 35 live benchmark queries (Phase 3 demo)
notes: Expected strings were checked by hand against the source documents: S3 values against the printed region tables and the reports' 5-year summary pages, S6 counts against the saved HTML (58 working + 3 dormant rows), S7 against the LGD exports. run_queries.py passes a query only if the intent, every expected string and the expected provenance all match.

queries.question: Which region had the highest paddy production in 2023-24?
queries.verified_against: 2023-24 report p51 Table V-B col (5) (text layer); regions sum to STATE 61306. Note: the 2024-25 summary prints 61299 for the same total (source inconsistency, docs/extraction_errors.md E4).

queries.question: Compare coconut area across Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe and Yanam in 2024-25
queries.verified_against: 2024-25 p52 render (eval case A2-14); UT 1797 = 2024-25 p41 summary

queries.question: Compare banana yield across the regions in 2020-21
queries.verified_against: 2020-21 p49 Table V-A col (14) Plantain; UT 61342 = 2022-23 p36 summary (Plantain yield 2020-21)
